# Format: {"name","w" (container width, CSS px),"css","html"} reproduce the case; every rect is [x,y,w,h] of the border box relative to the case container (a display:flow-root div at the page origin, margin 0), 3 decimals (Blink LayoutUnit = 1/64 px); "m" p = the paragraph (3 lines, <br>-separated); x.base = baseline y of each line relative to the paragraph top (bottom edge of a zero-size inline-block marker at the start of each line); x.runs = client rects of the text fragments (content area top/height) of the paragraph; x.fm = [ascent, descent] from canvas fontBoundingBox; x.lh/x.fs computed line-height and font-size; "m" border boxes by key (key ending [] = all matches in tree order), "t" first client rect of the element text (Range), "cs" computed style values (pseudo-elements are read with getComputedStyle(el, "::x")), "m0" the same rects as "m" with every transform neutralised, "x" extra values. The first line {"meta":...} gives the viewport (innerWidth, innerHeight = A4 794x1123 CSS px).
